title: A Study of LY3945262 in Healthy Participants
official: A Phase 1, Randomized, Investigator- and Participant-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled, Single- and Multiple-Ascending Dose Study to Characterize the Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacokinetics of LY3945262 and an Open Label, Randomized, Fixed Sequence, Relative Bioavailability Study of LY3945262 in Healthy Participants
summary:
The main purpose of this study is to evaluate how well LY3945262 is tolerated, what side effects may occur, and how much LY3945262 gets into the bloodstream and how long it takes the body to remove it in healthy participants. The study will also compare how LY3945262 gets into the bloodstream when administered in different ways.

This study will last approximately 8 weeks and may include up to 4 visits.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Are overtly healthy as determined by medical evaluation including medical history, physical examination, laboratory tests, vital signs, and electrocardiogram (ECG).

  * To qualify as Japanese for the purpose of this study, the participant must be first generation Japanese, defined as the participant, the participant's biological parents, and all the participant's biological grandparents must be of exclusive Japanese descent, and must have been born in Japan.
  * To qualify as Chinese for the purpose of this study, the participant must be at a minimum, third-generation Chinese, defined as all 4 of the participant's biological grandparents must be of exclusive Chinese descent, and must have been born in China.
* Individuals assigned male at birth (AMAB) and individuals not of childbearing potential (INOCBP) may participate in this trial. Individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) are excluded from this trial.
* Have a body weight of at least 50 kilogram (kg) and body mass index within the range of 18.5 to less than or equal to 35 kilogram per square meter (kg/m²).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a significant history, or current evidence, of any of the following types of disorders that could significantly alter the absorption, metabolism, or elimination of drugs; pose a risk during administration of the investigational product; or interfere with data interpretation:

  * cardiovascular
  * respiratory, including bronchospasm or bronchial asthma, or chronic obstructive airways disease
  * hepatic
  * renal
  * gastrointestinal
  * endocrine, such as diabetes, acromegaly, Cushing syndrome, hyper- or hypothyroidism (Including subclinical hypothyroidism measured using thyroid stimulating hormone), or hyperaldosteronism
  * hematological
* Have a history of hypertension, or a blood pressure (BP) reading that is abnormal for the population
* Have known or ongoing psychiatric disorders.
* Have used or intend to use over the counter or herbal supplements (for example, St. John's wort) or prescription medication within 14 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, before initial dosing or during the study. If this situation arises, inclusion of an otherwise suitable participant may be at the discretion of the investigator and sponsor.
* Regularly use known drugs of abuse and/or show positive findings on drug screening.
* Are currently enrolled in any other clinical trial involving an investigational intervention or any other type of medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study.
* Have participated, within the past 30 days, in a clinical study involving an investigational product with a short half-life. If the previous investigational product has a long half-life, 3 months or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, should have passed.
